criteria.basis: Unique named rows; predicates return None or their exact refusal code; only active table issuance can refuse.

Targeted PASS: exact operation/span exception allowances and verified propagation; registered predicate entry by known identity. B1/B5 probes fail with their specific runtime/protocol failures and zero credit.

PARTIAL capability: the outside-predicate scan is an explicit allowlist in which each automatic form has a written totality reason and everything else is an obligation. Name reads follow the language scope rules; module reads are certified from the syntax alone (one top-level unconditional binding before the read), never from the live namespace; class-body name operations are automatic only in a plain class. Exact plumbing declarations still need review.
Bounded PASS: direct pair enumeration with independently rebuilt equal case graphs and original state snapshots; all tested diagonal/off-diagonal regressions withhold credit correctly.

Bounded PASS: table swaps, peer preservation and restoration operate on certified initial state, and every cut row is checked by guard-call trace: the two uncut runs must agree, and a credited flip must repeat its baseline path through the cut guard. A source that is stable within one process but differs across runs stays a review item.
